_readme: One entry per shop. mode: 'scroll' for a long offers page, 'flipbook' for a page-turning folder viewer, 'pdf' for a page that links to a PDF folder. Check each url in a browser first: shops move these pages around.

nettorama.name: Nettorama
nettorama._checked: 2026-09-20: this page names the folder dates and embeds a Publitas viewer (view.publitas.com/bv-nettorama-verbruikersmarkten/actiefolder-<week>-<year>/). Next week's folder appears on /actiefolder-volgende-week every Friday from 17:00.
